# Step 2.77, part 1: the bin screen (builder's note)

**Brief check.** For a league's owner and admins. When done: a team, a person or a published game removed by mistake is found in the bin and brought back by taps alone. The done test checks exactly that at 390 wide, scripts off, plus a team with scripts on.
**Stock-take.** Already there: the core commands (`leagues.list_bin`, `restore_team`, `restore_person`, `restore_game`, which already refuses a game whose team is in the bin, and a team whose name was taken) and the database store. Missing: any screen; details on a bin line; the made-up stand-in's bin for teams and games (it threw); links from Teams and Schedule; the notice's way back.

**Part 2 stock-take (the activity log).**
- Read already there: `access.list_activity` (newest first, `before` only, no filters) and the database's `listActivityEntries`; the Admins page shows its ten latest access changes.
- The made-up world recorded entries without id or time and listed none (`list: async () => []`); the Admins page's stand-in reads a shell that lists none.
- Missing: filters (who, kind, dates), a newer page, a screen of its own, the season status in its entry, the way from a removal to the bin.

**Built (files)**

- `packages/core/src/modules/leagues/bin.ts`: optional `details` on a bin line (`BinDetails`).
- `packages/database/src/queries/list-binned.ts` + `stores/bin-commands.test.ts`: a team's games played and still to play, and who on its open roster is in the bin; a game's start and "no round".
- `apps/web/src/server/stand-in-world-bin.ts` (+ test): the stand-in lists teams, people and games and brings them back, with the database's refusals.
- `apps/web/src/features/bin-area/*`: the screen (`/[league]/admin/settings/bin`), the "Bring it back" action, the binned team's admin address, the links. The route is `app/[league]/admin/settings/bin/page.tsx`.
- Teams: "Removed teams and people" link, and "Bring it back" in the notice after a team or person is removed. Schedule: "Removed games". Team page: "This team is in the bin" for whoever may see the bin.
- Messages: `admin.bin.*` (admin.ts); `adminTeams.done.removed` / `personRemoved` say "Moved to the bin"; the two polish-list sentences (2.140, "ask the league's owner") now point to the bin; the next step added to `game-number-taken`, `person-profile-taken`, `team-name-taken`, `team-short-name-taken`.
- Tests: `tests/browser/bin-screen-test.mjs` (new). Re-pointed to the new words: `undo-removing-test.mjs` and `teams-area.test.ts` (the 2.161 pin). Bin rows added to `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` for every kind of person; the route added to `harmful-text-test.mjs`.
